title: Looking for Founding n8n Automation Creators | Osmium
brief_snippet:
Hey n8n builders! 

we’re Osmium, a newly launched marketplace for reusable software capabilities, AI systems, APIs, and automation tools.

We’re inviting 20 independent developers and automation creators to join our founding vendor cohort.

Who we’re looking for:




n8n builders with original, reusable automation solutions




AI agent and workflow developers




API and backend integration creators




Independent developers with working software they’d like to monetize



What we’re offering:




An additional channel to sell your existing work




Freedom to set your own prices




Ownership of your original software




Personal onboarding assistance




Opportunities to showcase available testing evidence



This is an independent vendor opportunity, not salaried employment. Earnings depend on actual sales, and we cannot guarantee customers.

If you’ve built something reusable, we’d love to explore bringing it to Osmium.

Interested? Email: heythere@osmiumcodes.com

Subject: Osmium Founding Vendor

Tell us what you’ve built and share a demo or portfolio if available.

Looking forward to meeting some brilliant builders!
